capabilities: Duplicate, join, sort, reverse and deduplicate lines
Insert blank lines and delete to line start or end
Build multi-cursor selections by selecting next or all occurrences
Jump to a line and column number
extras: No settings and no network access; no default hotkeys are assigned, so users must set their own; works in Source mode and Live Preview on desktop and mobile.
motivation: The author notes Obsidian already covers swapping lines and toggling lists, so the plugin fills the gaps rather than duplicating existing commands.
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks the line-level and multi-cursor editing commands (duplicate, sort, join, select next occurrence, go to line) that code editors provide.
summary: Set of editor commands that duplicate, join, sort, reverse and clean up lines and build multi-cursor selections, with one-step undo.
